# VCQ Portfolio — Full Public Reference

## Publisher identity
Name: VCQ
Type: Independent Android app publisher
Canonical portfolio hub: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/
Google Play developer page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=VCQ

## Portfolio

1. Tricky Words
A word puzzle game centered on finding hidden words, daily challenges, hints, achievements, rewards, league trophies and offline play.
Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/tricky-words/
Android package: com.vcqapp.trickywords

2. Celestia: Stars & Dreams AI
An AI-powered astrology and dream interpretation app with personalized horoscopes, birth charts, planetary transits, moon phases, dream journaling, compatibility and monthly energy forecasts.
Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/celestia/
Android package: com.vcqapp.celestia

3. Her Bloom Cycle Sync
An AI-powered period, ovulation and cycle-syncing companion with health coaching, cycle-synced recipes, symptom charts, Partner Sync and support across fertility, pregnancy, perimenopause and menopause journeys.
Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/herbloom/
Android package: com.vcqapp.herbloomcyclesync

4. HabitAI: Daily Habit Tracker
A daily habit tracker and goal planner with AI coaching, predictive streaks, Google Health Connect integration, challenges, gamification, flexible habit types and behavioral analytics.
Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/habitai/
Android package: com.vcqapp.dailyhabittracker

## Entity relationships
VCQ is the publisher. Tricky Words, Celestia, Her Bloom and HabitAI are separate Android applications in the VCQ portfolio. Each app has a dedicated canonical website and Google Play listing. The portfolio hub is the canonical page describing their relationship to VCQ.

## Discovery topics
Android apps; word puzzle game; AI astrology app; dream interpreter; period tracker; ovulation tracker; cycle syncing; AI habit coach; daily habit tracker; Health Connect; productivity and wellness apps.
